name: editor
description: Project file editor with Monaco, file management, image and Markdown previews, and read-only Git history. Disabling it removes the editor UI and makes its grandfathered project-file API unavailable while project registration and task Git history remain available.

strings.workspaceIntro: Project files, working changes and previews in one focused editing surface.
